infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HydraPulse uses your camera to measure your pulse waveform for hydration estimation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HydraPulse uses your microphone for voice timbre analysis to support hydration assessment.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: HydraPulse reads heart rate and HRV data from Apple Health to enhance hydration insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: HydraPulse saves your hydration scores to Apple Health.
